items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: Now, this drummer that I told you a while back that we got to play with us in Homer, his name was, we used to call him Shine.

ctx.x: And who were the Southern Syncopators? Do you remember that band? Well, the Southern Syncopators, they were from New Orleans. I think that was Sidney Desvigny. I see. I get all these things mixed up. Yeah, Sidney Desvigny.
Now, this drummer that I told you a while back that we got to play with us in Homer, his name was, we used to call him Shine.
